textos.O meio-termo é o maior grupo da recepção: The middle group is the largest in the reception (~41% of ratings). Opinions converge when analyzing the script and the relationship with the earlier films, but diverge in the assessment: most of those who recommend it consider the production an underrated reimagining that compiles the originals well, while about half of those who do not recommend it criticize absurd actions taken by generic characters.
textos.O reviewer reclama que o filme parece ma: The reviewer complains that the film feels more like porn than horror, with excessive nudity and sex scenes, including a moment in which a young woman is dragged so that her breasts are exposed for no reason, plus sexualized songs and jokes the whole time.
textos.O reviewer critica os personagens por se: The reviewer criticizes the characters for being superficial, stupid and making predictable decisions, such as splitting up and going to isolated places, making it hard to root for them or care about their fate.
textos.O reviewer aponta que a história é formu: The reviewer points out that the story is formulaic, following every slasher cliché, with no surprises, and that the plot feels like a collage of the franchise's earlier parts, adding nothing new.
textos.O reviewer sente que Jason perdeu a essê: The reviewer feels that Jason has lost his original essence, since he now runs and acts like a fighter, and even kidnaps a girl, something that does not fit the slow, methodical killer of the old films, besides not having the same charisma.
textos.O reviewer reclama que a iluminação é tã: The reviewer complains that the lighting is so dark in many scenes that you cannot see what is happening, undermining the fear and the experience, and that the cinematography seems lazy and uninspired.
textos.O reviewer critica os diálogos por serem: The reviewer criticizes the dialogue for being artificial and poorly written, and the performances for being weak, with characters who are unconvincing and stand out only for their physical appearance.
textos.Vários espectadores notaram que esta ver: Several viewers noted that this version of Jason is the scariest and most physically imposing of the series, being smarter, running, setting traps and using tunnels, which makes him more human and less supernatural.
textos.Muitos comentaram que os personagens são: Many commented that the characters are stereotyped, disposable and hard to root for, with the exception of a few such as Clay, Jenna and even Trent as a memorable villain.
textos.Parte do público apontou que o filme tem: A portion of the audience pointed out that the film has an exaggerated amount of sexual content and nudity, typical of 2000s horror, which bothered some.
textos.Houve quem reclamasse dos diálogos de ba: Some complained about the low-quality dialogue and the predictable script, which brings no surprises and leans on genre clichés.
textos.Boa compilação dos filmes originais: Good compilation of the original films
textos.Vários espectadores elogiaram a forma co: Several viewers praised the way the remake blends elements of the franchise's first films, working as a collection that pleases fans.
textos.Alguns apontaram que o filme tem boa dir: Some pointed out that the film has good direction and well-shot scenes, but suffers from shaky camera work and frenetic editing, leaving the action confusing and without suspense.
textos.Este grupo considera que a versão de Jas: This group considers that this film's version of Jason is the most intimidating and violent of the whole franchise, highlighting his aggression, cunning and the impact of his creative kills.
textos.Muitas reviews positivas argumentam que: Many positive reviews argue that the film received unfair criticism and that it is superior to other remakes and to most of the original sequels, being considered one of the best entries in the series.
textos.Estrutura como melhor dos primeiros film: Structure as the best of the early films
textos.Os fãs apreciam como o roteiro condensa: Fans appreciate how the script condenses the first three films into a single narrative, with a strong opening and a more cohesive development of the Jason character.
textos.Personagem de destaque: Clay e sua busca: Standout character: Clay and his search
textos.O protagonista Clay é bem recebido por s: The protagonist Clay is well received for his determination to find his missing sister, making him a captivating hero and different from typical slasher survivors.

textos.Embora muitos apreciem a diversão e o to: Although many enjoy the fun and the over-the-top tone, a portion of the group considers the sex scenes exaggerated and unnecessary, suggesting that cutting them back would improve the film's acceptance.
textos.A ambientação no acampamento e o uso de: The camp setting and the use of underground tunnels are praised as elements that enrich the mythology and heighten the sense of danger, in addition to highlighting the film's aesthetic.

textos.Dirigido por Marcus Nispel e lançado em: Directed by Marcus Nispel and released in 2009, the horror and suspense feature Friday the 13th follows a group of teenagers at Crystal Lake. Far from civilization in what was meant to be a quiet stay, they gradually discover the region's bloody past and face a violent quest for revenge.
textos.A experiência do filme é marcada por uma: The film's experience is marked by a narrative structure that gathers elements from the franchise's original chapters and by a constant presence of nudity and sexuality.
textos.Os três grupos concordam sobre o que o f: The three groups agree on what the film is and disagree on whether it works. In a good portion of the ratings (~41%), several highlight the presence of a more active, threatening Jason. However, some point to shallow, irritating characters, while a smaller slice mentions the excess of sex and nudity.
textos.Numa parte menor das notas (~33%), a ins: In a smaller portion of the ratings (~33%), dissatisfaction stands out: for them, a significant share criticizes the sexualization and gratuitous nudity throughout the plot. At the same time, a good portion condemns the presence of generic characters who make idiotic decisions, and a considerable number point to a weak, predictable script stuck in genre clichés.
textos.Por fim, numa parcela das notas (~26%),: Finally, in a share of the ratings (~26%), the reception is favorable: in this reading, most celebrate the killer in a scarier, more brutal version, while a large portion defend the title as an underrated remake. In addition, many approve of the narrative structure conceived as a synthesis of the first films.
